description: Add a parcel to an order: the items it carries, carrier, tracking and status. This is also how an order is marked fulfilled. The order's fulfillment and delivery status follow its parcels; a pending parcel (no label yet) fulfils nothing.

items.description: Lines and quantities in this parcel. Omit to send every unit not yet in a shipment

labelUrl.description: http(s) link to the printable shipping label

note.description: Saved in the parcel's status history

status.description: Defaults to label_purchased with a tracking number, else pending. Use delivered for an order handed over in person, in_transit for one sent without tracking

trackingUrl.description: http(s) link to track the parcel

name: create_shipment
title: Create shipment
